etymology.historical_story: In English naming tradition, Dicky is a familiar form of Richard. Merriam-Webster also identifies that nickname in the history of the English clothing word dickey. The shared spelling illustrates why names and ordinary words must be separated carefully. Without the original Malay sentence, neither that English noun nor any particular person's identity can be assigned to this token. Source: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/dicky).

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 按本人偏好称呼；正式场合若确认对方为成年男性，可用 Encik Dicky。不能仅凭昵称推断其证件姓名为 Richard。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 登记、邮件和名单应保留本人使用的拼写，避免擅改为 Dickie 或 Dickey，也不应拿姓名的外语谐音开玩笑。
